mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 3-month moving average signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% (UNRATE) indicates labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and declines in CPIAUCSL signal a successful 'soft landing' monetary policy, stabilizing growth expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL falling) occurs in more than 50% of periods, but SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of those periods.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), aggressive Fed tightening increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% YoY, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production level (INDPRO) relative to its 3-month moving average indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1200.0 thousand units (HOUST) signals a housing market contraction, reducing consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer spending slowdown, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (HOUST and RSAFS both declining) occurs in more than 50% of periods, but SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of those periods.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), tight labor markets support wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.
